text: I think you'll really enjoy this Mexican-Style Rice recipe, which is not only quick to make but also fits within your 30-minute time frame. As a pasta lover, you might appreciate the simplicity and flavor of this dish, and the addition of chicken stock will give it a rich and savory taste. Since you don't have any dietary constraints related to meat, I've opted for the chicken stock option. Plus, this recipe is nut-free, so you don't have to worry about any allergens. Give it a try!
